concepts.name: 유리 ㅎ
concepts.rationale: ㅎ 단독 글자를 반투명 유리 조형물로 만들어 한녕의 이름과 연결.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a review board showing one new Han-nyeong / "한녕" macOS app icon with its matching input-source menu symbol.
Brand meaning: automatically fluid Korean-English typing, saying goodbye to the manual language-switch key.
The user rejected previous flat artwork and all ㅎ+ㄴ combinations. Create a sophisticated dimensional icon, NOT cute.
Composition: landscape 3:2 pure white review canvas. Left half: one large front-facing macOS squircle app icon, enough visible tile thickness, realistic studio-lit materials. Right half: the corresponding small-menu identity mark shown enlarged in solid pure black, with no colored tile behind it, same essential shape. Only these TWO items, aligned horizontally and optically balanced with generous margins. No captions, slogans, watermarks, annotations, numbers, or extra demonstrations.
App artwork must have convincing physical depth through beveled geometry, restrained ambient occlusion, contact shadows, side surfaces, highlights, and intentionally controlled material transitions. Premium desktop-software aesthetic, crafted product rendering rather than a flat vector glyph on a flat square. Do not merely add a generic drop shadow to flat shapes.
The right menu symbol is deliberately simplified monochrome so the identity can remain readable at 16–20 points; retain clear distinctive contours, generous gaps, no hairlines. It must match the main app mark's front silhouette, not become a generic circle.
Research principles: dimensional glass and lighting from PixelResort's Kaleidoscope process, tactile functional storytelling from Iconfactory's MuseBox process, material/typographic depth from Ramotion's 3D brand identity principles. Use these GENERAL design principles, never reproduce their actual marks, triangle prisms, trees, or company logos.
Avoid: ㅎㄴ, ㅎ·ㄴ, ㄴ, Hangul monogram combinations, stacked Hangul initials, mascots, faces, smiles, toy clay, cartoon style, candy colors, overbusy scenes, generic AI sparkles, generic infinity logo, copied brand logos. No Latin letters unless explicitly requested; Korean ㅎ is permitted only in specified concepts.
Primary request: A single bold Korean consonant ㅎ formed from thick sculptural frosted optical glass, with polished beveled rims catching an icy teal-blue highlight. EXACT Hangul geometry: a short horizontal cap at top, a longer horizontal bar below it, then one closed circular ring below. Clear gap between each piece; no ㄴ anywhere. Raised transparent glass letter parts with real sidewalls, visible refraction and depth, physically cast soft shadows onto a smoky midnight-teal glass squircle tile. Camera nearly orthographic and front-on so the Hangul reads instantly; show bevel thickness mainly on the lower-right edges. Large circular counter. Restrained turquoise, pale ice and graphite. The matching right symbol is exactly this thick ㅎ front silhouette in black, with three separate parts. This is recognizable Korean identity with luxurious glass depth, no cartoon softness.

concepts.name: 한영키에 안녕
concepts.rationale: 키보드 키캡을 상징으로 삼아 ‘한영키에 안녕’이라는 제품 의미를 직접 표현.

Distinctive sculpted keycap metaphor says goodbye to the manual switching key, without crossing it out.

Upper-facing side is deep cobalt anodized metal, folded reverse is brushed warm champagne metal; the color change is due to the two faces of ONE ribbon. The matching RIGHT symbol is the same diagonal broad S-ribbon contour as a solid black graphic, with a clearly separated slit at the fold showing its topology. Keep it compact, asymmetric and identifiable.

Primary request: An original architectural language portal: one thick rounded-rectangle frame standing front-on, a large open center, formed from faceted optical crystal. Its LEFT vertical face catches cool cyan-blue light, its RIGHT face catches warm amber light, merging naturally across a pearl-clear top arch and lower sill. This TWO-temperature material represents two languages passing through one clear opening. A SINGLE short vertical graphite typing-caret floats centered inside the opening, with generous space around it, no horizontal crossbars, no Hangul letters, no A. The frame has distinct physical sidewalls, cut-glass edge bevels, subtle inner refraction and realistic shadow onto a charcoal macOS squircle tile; not a lens flare, no aura, no neon scene. Sophisticated hardware-like prismatic object, purposeful and quiet. The matching RIGHT menu mark is a thick solid black rounded-rectangle portal outline with one short bold vertical caret inside; maintain the same opening proportion, no arrow, no power-button circle. Distinct from the single keycap and ribbon concepts.
